messages:
People Ops: Putting together a short manager cheat-sheet for calibration + comp conversations that explicitly accounts for parental leave / reduced scope. Want something copy-pasteable that keeps calibration fast and fair. Thoughts? :balance_scale:

dylan: Love this. Need clear tags so reviewers can filter notes in the calibration doc (e.g., 'leave-adjusted', 'promo-signal:impact').

priya: Agree. Also include tiny guidance on how to normalize metrics when an IC was on leave for part of the cycle. A sentence or two is enough.

People Ops: Draft below. It's intentionally tiny: 3 manager micro-comments, 2 tags, and a single normalization guideline. Copy-paste ready.

--- pasteable MANAGER NOTES (calibration-friendly) ---
1) Micro-summary (1 line): "Role / 1-line impact + scope" e.g., "Platform IC / cut perf tail by 10% for enterprise routes (owned infra + ops)."
2) Promo-signal (one word): leadership | impact | scope | none
3) Comp/level note (1 line): e.g., "Level match: above|on|below expectations for current level"
4) Tags (optional): leave-adjusted | cross-team | interim-owner

Normalization guidance (one sentence): "If `leave-adjusted` tag is present, scale numeric claims by prorating the active weeks (e.g., 60% active -> compare to 60% benchmark) and surface raw + prorated numbers for calibration."

Manager micro-replies (3 words max) to keep notes concise: "Amplify + owner?", "Promote candidate", "Level raise: discuss"

Example entry (pasteable):
"Platform IC / reduced p95 tail by 10% for heavy routes; Promo-signal: impact; Level: on expectations; Tags: leave-adjusted; Evidence: grafana/r/77 (raw) + prorated: -6% (60% active); Ask: approve extension for quarter."

nate: Can we add a one-line rule for people returning from leave who had scope limited? e.g., prefer growth plan vs immediate promotion unless sustained impact for a full quarter.

People Ops: Added a guidance line: "Return-from-leave rule: favor development plan + 1-quarter runway; exceptions require explicit calibration comment with supporting evidence."

comp-ops-bot: Note: Compensation committee prefers entries to include `Promo-signal` tag and one supporting metric. I'll auto-flag entries missing those fields during packet ingest.

priya: Tiny wording tweak: change 'scale numeric claims' -> 'prorate numeric claims' for clarity.

People Ops: Done. Finalizing copy into the calibration playbook and review packet. Will include quick paste buttons in the doc so managers can drop these into calibration sheets. Approve with :white_check_mark: if you're good. :sparkles:
